items.answer:
<dbt_model_sql>
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

with directors as (
    select director_id, first_name, last_name
    from {{ ref('stg_imdb_directors') }}
),
director_movies as (
    select
        d.director_id,
        md.movie_id,
        m.imdb_rank
    from directors d
    left join {{ ref('stg_imdb_movie_directors') }} md on d.director_id = md.director_id
    left join {{ ref('stg_imdb_movies') }} m on md.movie_id = m.movie_id
),
agg as (
    select
        director_id,
        count(distinct movie_id) as movie_count,
        avg(imdb_rank) as avg_imdb_rank
    from director_movies
    group by director_id
)
select
    d.director_id,
    d.first_name,
    d.last_name,
    coalesce(agg.movie_count, 0) as movie_count,
    agg.avg_imdb_rank,
    rank() over (order by agg.avg_imdb_rank asc nulls last, d.director_id asc) as director_rank
from directors d
left join agg on d.director_id = agg.director_id
order by director_rank asc
</dbt_model_sql>
